checked_claims: Mozart is the composer of Die Zauberflöte / The Magic Flute, KV 620.
The work is a Singspiel in two acts and premiered at Vienna's Freihaus-Theater on 30 September 1791.
Emanuel Schikaneder was the theatre impresario and performed Papageno; Josepha Hofer sang the Queen of the Night; Mozart conducted the first performances from a keyboard.
The displayed Köchel entry lists an overture, aria, and spoken dialogue components.
items.distractor_review: Bizet, Verdi, and Puccini do not compose this named work. The question asks for its composer, so the answer is unique and does not confuse Schikaneder's text or stage role with Mozart's music.

checked_claims: Puccini is the composer of Turandot and Alfano later completed its third act.
Adami and Simoni are the librettists; the work is described as three acts and five scenes.
The world premiere was at La Scala on 25 April 1926.
The first performance ended after Liù's death without an Alfano ending; the second and third used the revised Alfano ending.
items.distractor_review: Bizet, Mozart, and Verdi are unrelated to Turandot's composition. Franco Alfano is deliberately named in the stem as a later completer, so he cannot displace Puccini as the principal-composer answer.
